column7: \data Acc {A : \Set} (R : A -> A -> \Prop) (a : A) | acc (\Pi {b : A} -> R b a -> Acc R b)
\lemma map-acc {A B : \Set} (f : A -> B) {R : B -> B -> \Prop} {a : A} (acc : Acc R (f a)) : Acc (\lam a1 a2 => R (f a1) (f a2)) a
